title: About Oldham Tuition Centre
text: Oldham Tuition Centre provides personalised tuition for children and young people. We specialise in Maths, English, Science, and Coding, with GCSE support for AQA, Edexcel, and OCR exam boards. We also run the First Class Learning (FCL) programme for ages 6–18. Maximum 4 students per tutor for focused attention. We are Ofsted registered. Eligible families may receive childcare support covering up to 85% of fees.

title: Subjects and programmes
text: Subjects: Maths, English, Science, Coding. GCSE preparation for Maths, English, and Sciences (AQA, Edexcel, OCR). First Class Learning (FCL) structured programme for ages 6–18 with daily worksheets plus centre support. Regular tuition sessions are also personalised with small groups (max 4 per tutor). Both start with a free skills assessment.

title: Class times (informational)
text: Regular session times (for information — bookings are arranged by phone after a free skills assessment): Saturday and Sunday 11:00am–1:00pm; Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday 4:15pm–6:15pm. The team will confirm availability when they call.

title: Free skills assessment
text: We offer a free skills assessment for new students. It helps us see your child's level and recommend the right programme. Arrive a few minutes early; the session is relaxed with no pressure to sign up on the day. Preferred days and times can be noted during SMS enquiry; our team will call to confirm. Phone: 07957 188 421.

title: Pricing and fees
text: Fees depend on subject, year group, and programme (FCL vs regular tuition). We keep groups small (max 4 per tutor) for value and attention. Eligible families may receive childcare support up to 85%. For exact fees, the team will discuss options on the call after your free skills assessment — share any published ranges warmly if the parent asks, then invite the assessment.

title: Parent FAQs — child behind or nervous
text: Many parents contact us because their child is behind at school or lacks confidence. The free skills assessment finds the right starting point — no judgement. Small groups (max 4 per tutor) help nervous children settle. Parents are welcome to ask questions when the team calls.

title: Parent FAQs — exam stress (GCSE)
text: We support GCSE Maths, English, and Sciences across AQA, Edexcel, and OCR. Tuition is tailored to exam boards and gaps identified in the assessment. We focus on building confidence as well as subject knowledge.

title: Coding programme
text: Coding sessions welcome beginners from around age 8 upwards — no prior experience needed. Small groups, practical projects, and progression at each child's pace. Free skills assessment to find the right starting level.

title: Location and contact
text: Oldham Tuition Centre, 274 Manchester Road, Oldham OL9 7EL. Phone: 07957 188 421. Website: oldhamtuitioncentre.com

title: Small groups and quality
text: We keep groups small — a maximum of 4 students per tutor — so every child gets individual attention. Lessons follow personalised plans aligned to school curriculum and exam requirements where relevant.
